title: RadioArchive: calls and listeners
description: Recordings stored, calls rejected (R12, R17, R18), recordings missing (R19) and overlapping calls (R13); the live delay (R38); listeners' sockets and the limits they hit (R70-R73). Talkgroups appear only by their IDs (P1).

panels.title: Recordings uploaded
panels.description: Recording uploads in each 5 minutes, by the server's answer: stored, duplicate (a retry of one already stored), or a refusal.

panels.title: Calls rejected
panels.description: Calls refused in each 5 minutes: not attached (R12), an unknown talkgroup with auto-create off (R17), or an ignored talkgroup (R18).

panels.title: Recordings missing
panels.description: Calls that ended between 10 minutes and a day ago whose recording hasn't arrived (R19). Worry: anything above 0 (the "Recordings missing" alert).

panels.title: Unknown and ignored talkgroups rejected
panels.description: Calls rejected on a talkgroup ID the system doesn't have (unknown_talkgroup), or an ignored one, over the retention period, by system and talkgroup ID (R17, R18).

panels.title: Overlapping calls in the last 24 hours
panels.description: Two recorders on the same system and talkgroup whose calls overlap (R13). Keeping their coverage apart is trunk-recorder's config; the server stores both copies.

panels.title: Live delay
panels.description: From a live call's first PCM at the recorder to the server passing its first frame on, p50 and p95 over 5 minutes (R38). Worry: p95 above 2 s for 5 minutes (the "Live delay high" alert).

panels.title: Listeners' sockets
panels.description: Listener WebSockets open, and LIMIT_LIVE_TOTAL (R71). At the limit, new listeners see "The radio is full"; for 10 minutes, it alerts. Zips being sent (R72) on the right.

panels.title: Limit hits
panels.description: Requests refused over a heavy-use limit in each 5 minutes (R70-R73): requests (120 a minute), playback (600 a minute), live (4 per client, 50 in all) and zip (2 per client, 6 in all). On dashboards only (R91).

panels.title: Live feed
panels.description: Frames queued for listeners and dropped from slow listeners' full queues, a second; and the feed's events in each 5 minutes: calls withdrawn when a talkgroup is hidden (R31), delayed calls released (R23), slow listeners closed.
